State_change_caption: The transition of the button from its initial unpressed state to being fully pressed is a smooth progression. Initially at rest, the button begins to depress under the force of the finger, altering its reflective qualities and shifting the angle of its surface. As the finger continues to exert pressure, the button moves downward until it reaches its maximum range of motion. Throughout this sequence, the surrounding area remains largely unaffected, with only the light and shadows dancing across the button's surface indicating the dynamic action taking place.
